name: Kind-aware warm Pod candidate matching
target: One production candidate scorer selects exact Pod kind; gate reuse requires exact cut SHA, lock hash, and image digest while runtime architecture is exact unless an explicit amd64/arm64 allowlist is configured
inputs: exact architecture by default and explicit amd64/arm64 allowlist
observations: implementation and gate paths reject a candidate of the other kind
gate path rejects any cut SHA, lock hash, or image digest mismatch
cross-architecture candidates fail closed by default and match only when both architectures are allowlisted
implementation ALLOC-RETURN reaches two lease generations on the same cleaned Pod UID through the shared scorer
implementation digest drift is observed; gate mismatch reasons are explicit
